assertionResults.title: Empty state

steps.expected: A clear no-results empty state with guidance text such as 'No email deliveries found. Adjust filters to see more results.'
steps.observed: Only the page header, filters, and tabs rendered. No empty-state message or guidance text appeared.

steps.action: Open /email-delivery?page=999 as an out-of-range pagination fallback
steps.expected: A truthful empty/no-results state with visible recovery guidance.
steps.observed: Pagination rendered 'Showing 0-0 of 0 results' with Prev/Next controls, but no explanatory empty-state copy or guidance text was visible.

evidence.network: GET /api/ops/email-delivery?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c&range=7d&page=1&pageSize=50 -> request observed while filtered no-results URL rendered only shell; no empty-state guidance visible

assertionResults.issues: Empty/no-results guidance text was not rendered for either deterministic zero-result filter or out-of-range page.

assertionResults.title: Error state

steps.expected: An error alert with meaningful message and a retry action renders instead of a loading shell.
steps.observed: Only the header/filter shell rendered. No alert text, no retry button, and no visible error message appeared.

steps.action: Inspect visible buttons and alert roles after forced-error request
steps.expected: Retry control exists and alert content is exposed in the DOM.
steps.observed: Buttons present were only tabs/filters/clear controls; DOM query found zero [role=alert] elements.

evidence.network: GET /api/ops/email-delivery?restaurantId=a050d1ad-1ee0-4ea0-abc2-22c3778aa52c&range=7d&page=1&pageSize=50&simulateEmailDeliveryError=1&messageId=__force_error__ -> request observed; UI stayed on shell with no retry affordance

assertionResults.issues: Forced-error contract was not surfaced in the UI: no visible alert, no meaningful message, and no retry action.

frictions.description: After password login, the app redirected to /dashboard instead of /email-delivery, so the assigned page had to be opened manually after authentication.
frictions.resolution: Navigated directly to the assigned /email-delivery route after successful sign-in.

summary: Tested 2 assertions via authenticated browser flow. Both failed: the no-results state showed no guidance copy, and the forced-error state showed no alert or retry action despite the error-trigger request being issued.
